def make_slug(title):
    import re
    lowered = title.lower()
    if not lowered:
        return ""
    collapsed = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered)
    trimmed = collapsed.strip("-")
    return trimmed

def split_into_batches(seq, n):
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError("batch size must be positive")
    batches = []
    starts = range(0, len(seq), n)
    batches = [list(seq[i:i + n]) for i in starts]
    return batches

def to_roman(n):
    if not 1 <= n <= 3999:
        raise ValueError("unsupported number")
    ones = ["", "I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX"]
    tens = ["", "X", "XX", "XXX", "XL", "L", "LX", "LXX", "LXXX", "XC"]
    hundreds = ["", "C", "CC", "CCC", "CD", "D", "DC", "DCC", "DCCC", "CM"]
    thousands = ["", "M", "MM", "MMM"]
    return thousands[n // 1000] + hundreds[n // 100 % 10] + tens[n // 10 % 10] + ones[n % 10]

def gcd(a, b):
    a, b = abs(a), abs(b)
    while b:
        remainder = a % b
        a = b
        b = remainder
    return a

def unpack_message(data):
    fields = []
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(data):
        colon = data.index(":", pos)
        size = int(data[pos:colon])
        start = colon + 1
        fields.append(data[start:start + size])
        pos = start + size
    return fields
note: length-prefix packer vs unpacker
'>' flipped to '>=' (boundary now exclusive)

def clamp_to_range(x, lo, hi):
    if lo > hi:
        raise ValueError("empty range")
    upper = min(x, hi)
    lower = max(lo, upper)
    result = lower
    return result

def clamp_value(x, lo, hi):
    if lo > hi:
        raise ValueError("empty range")
    upper = min(x, hi)
    lower = min(lo, upper)
    result = lower
    return result
